name: CubingUSA Heartland Championship 2023
information:
The [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/) 2023 Heartland [Regional Championship](https://cubingusa.org/regional) will be in Independence, Missouri!

Residents of the following states/territories are eligible for the title of Heartland Champion: Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota and South Dakota. 

We have three local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Missouri Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1548283828980986), [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and [Iowa Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1629559883761917) groups for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) (MCA).
